headerDisplay: Brink Flair via Brink Home. Enter your Brink Home login above; it is stored encrypted, not in config.json. All names below default to Dutch and can be changed. HomeKit keeps the name of an accessory that is already added, so rename those in the Home app.
footerDisplay: Like this plugin? Support it at [garia.net](https://garia.net) or [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/garianet).

pollSeconds.title: Refresh interval (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often values are read from Brink Home. Minimum 30.

picker.title: Show level picker tile
picker.description: Extra tile with named levels, like the inputs of a TV. Add it separately in the Home app with the bridge setup code.

autoName.title: Picker: automatic mode
autoName.description: The unit controls the level itself.

supplyAirName.title: Supply air temperature sensor name
supplyAirName.description: Air blown into the house after heat recovery.

filterName.title: Filter status name
filterName.description: Filter indication shown on the fan tile.

alertSensors.title: Alert sensors for notifications
alertSensors.description: Contact sensors that open when the filter needs replacing or the unit reports a fault. Turn on notifications for them in the Home app.

filterAlertName.title: Filter alert sensor name
filterAlertName.description: Opens when the filter needs replacing.

faultAlertName.title: Fault alert sensor name
faultAlertName.description: Opens when the unit reports a fault.
